profile.name: 罗德与施瓦茨测试仪器
profile.description: 这是一类支持 VISA/SCPI 远程控制的罗德与施瓦茨电子测试仪器，可通过 TCP/IP 等接口接入实验室自动化系统。常见用途包括远程参数设置、触发测量、读取波形或测量结果，以及进行自动化测试与数据采集。
profile.description_en: This refers to a Rohde & Schwarz electronic test instrument that supports remote control through VISA/SCPI, typically connected over interfaces such as TCP/IP. In laboratories, such instruments are used for automated setup, triggering measurements, reading waveforms or measurement results, and collecting data in test workflows.
